name: The Monk Zinon, Fast-Keeper and Toil-Lover, of Pechersk in the Farther Caves
life: The Monk Zinon, Fast-Keeper and Toil-Lover, of Pechersk in the Farther Caves: In the Third Ode of the Canon to the Monks of the Farther Caves, he is acclaimed as "resplendid in fast". His memory is celebrated also on 28 August and the 2nd Sunday of Great Lent.
